subject: Math
skill: Ratios Rates Proportional Relationships And Units
prompt: The area of a circular region is increasing at a rate of $48,000$ square centimeters per hour. Which of the following is closest to this rate in square meters per minute? (Use $1$ meter $= 100$ centimeters.)
explanation: Choice C is correct. To convert the rate from square centimeters per hour to square meters per minute, both the area units and time units must be converted. Since $1$ meter $= 100$ centimeters, squaring both sides gives $1$ square meter $= (100)^2 = 10{,}000$ square centimeters. For time conversion, $1$ hour $= 60$ minutes. Converting the area units: $48{,}000$ square centimeters per hour $\times \frac{1 \text{ square meter}}{10{,}000 \text{ square centimeters}} = \frac{48{,}000}{10{,}000} = 4.8$ square meters per hour. Converting the time units: $4.8$ square meters per hour $\times \frac{1 \text{ hour}}{60 \text{ minutes}} = \frac{4.8}{60} = 0.08$ square meters per minute. Therefore, the rate is closest to $0.08$ square meters per minute.
